# `environment-damage` content schema

<!-- Generated by pnpm content:docs from the "environment-damage" schema in src/content/registry.ts; do not edit. -->

One JSON file per entry in `src/content/data/environment-damage/`. Fields marked "required" must be present;
every other field takes the default shown when omitted ("—" = stays absent).

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | id | required | Rule set id, e.g. "default". |
| `name` | string | required | Display name (debug tools and docs). |
| `notes` | string | required | Why these values (design targets, references), for owner review. |
| `fall` | object | required | Fall and wall-impact damage: a fraction of max health from the equivalent drop height. Soft ground (impactAbsorb) takes off its share. |
| `fall.safeHeight` | number 0–100 | required | Equivalent drop at or below which a landing does no damage, m. |
| `fall.lethalHeight` | number > 0 ≤ 100 | required | Equivalent drop that deals 100% of max health, m; damage rises linearly from safeHeight. Above safeHeight. |
| `fall.deepWater` | number > 0 ≤ 100 | required | Landing in liquid at least this deep takes no fall damage, m. |
| `kinetic` | object | required | Falling and thrown physics objects striking creatures. |
| `kinetic.minSpeed` | number 0–100 | required | Relative speed a physics object must exceed to hurt a creature it strikes, m/s. |
| `kinetic.joulesPerPoint` | number > 0 | required | Blunt damage = ½·m·v² / joulesPerPoint (kinetic energy of the strike, J). |
| `hazards` | list of object | required | Hazard volumes, by the property that makes them. |
| `hazards[].when` | `"burning"` | required | The boolean world property that makes an entity this hazard (e.g. burning). |
| `hazards[].perSecond` | map of `"slash"` \| `"pierce"` \| `"blunt"` \| `"fire"` \| `"frost"` \| `"shock"` \| `"arcane"` \| `"poison"` → number > 0 | required | Damage per second, per damage type, to a creature within reach. |
| `hazards[].reach` | number 0–10 | required | How far beyond the hazard entity’s bounding sphere it hurts, m. |
| `hazards[].pulseMs` | integer > 0 ≤ 1000 | required | Damage lands in pulses this far apart, whole ms (perSecond × pulse length each). |
